feature: 01. Bank CSV import and import history
backend_status: Implemented service: batch hash, row provenance, all-or-nothing validation, duplicate handling.
api_status: Absent: no import or import-batch endpoint in the route table.
ui_status: Absent: no upload/import screen or import history.
gaps_limitations: Only the synthetic five-column CSV shape date,description,amount_inr,type,reference is parsed. Import and normalization/classification require separate service calls; there is no browser ingestion pipeline. Original file storage is caller-supplied through optional fileReference, not automatic archival by this importer.

feature: 02. Real bank/card/UPI formats; XLSX/PDF statements; manual cash transactions
backend_status: Partial: generic Payment model and one CSV parser. No additional transaction-source adapters or manual payment service.
api_status: Absent for transaction import. Evidence file upload is a different operation.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: Storing a PDF/screenshot as Evidence does not parse its transactions into Payments. Bank-specific CSV mapping, UPI exports, XLSX/PDF transaction extraction, cash/manual movement entry and email forwarding are unbuilt.

feature: 03. Deterministic and possible-duplicate handling
backend_status: Implemented: conclusive reference/amount/time/direction matching; ignored copies remain traceable; ambiguous pairs need a decision.
api_status: Present: GET /api/review; POST /api/review/payments/:paymentId/duplicate. Import dedup itself is service-only.
ui_status: Present in Review: compare, confirm duplicate, dismiss, reason dialog.
gaps_limitations: A functioning review surface for existing payments. There is still no website import flow to populate the queue from new statements.

feature: 04. Transaction normalization and merchant resolution
backend_status: Implemented deterministic channel refinement and exact merchant-alias matching, only on imported payments.
api_status: Absent: no normalize endpoint.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: No AI normalizeMerchant implementation, fuzzy alias review, merchant-management UI, or automatic normalization after a browser import. Unknown merchants stay unknown.

feature: 05. Expense-versus-settlement AI classification and purpose/category
backend_status: Implemented proposal/validation/approval pipeline; classification service can recognize matched self-transfers without AI.
api_status: Partial: review decision and reclassify endpoints; no initial classify/batch-classify endpoint.
ui_status: Partial: inspect and accept/reject an existing seeded/stored proposal. No initial classify control.
gaps_limitations: The server ModelTransport always rejects. Live AI proposals cannot be generated in this checkout. The AI contract covers expense or settlement, not an automatic investment/refund/income classifier.

feature: 06. Transfers and investment exclusion
backend_status: Implemented accounting semantics and deterministic self-transfer detection; investment-tagged movements are excluded from spending.
api_status: No dedicated classification/editor endpoint for these meanings.
ui_status: Totals are visible; no transfer-pairing or investment-classification control.
gaps_limitations: Investment support means recognizing an already-tagged payment during calculations. No service was found that classifies an ordinary imported payment as investment_instrument. Investment performance/valuation is explicitly outside scope.

feature: 07. Cash-flow category lifecycle: refund, peer settlement, internal transfer, external inflow
backend_status: Implemented separate normalize/classify/approve/reject lifecycle with direction and ledger-evidence gates.
api_status: Absent: cash-flow service functions are not mounted as routes.
ui_status: Absent: no credit-review queue or cash-category decision controls.
gaps_limitations: This is a major completion gap for the cash waterfall: users can see unexplained credits/debits but cannot approve their cash meaning through the website. Refund and settlement facts do not themselves expose this lifecycle.

feature: 08. Human review: accept/reject, explanation and provenance
backend_status: Implemented attributable decisions, validation and audit events; derived expenses become approved only after acceptance.
api_status: Present: review queue and inference decision routes.
ui_status: Present: filters, ranked queue, inspector, model/proposal provenance, explicit dialogs and Show more.
gaps_limitations: The workflow still stops after approving an expense if an initial allocation is needed: there is no allocation-authoring UI. Review is over supported queue kinds, not every unexplained movement or unapproved cash category.

feature: 09. Correct a proposal or retry a rejected classification
backend_status: Implemented modify with modifiedOutput and explicit reclassify service.
api_status: Present: POST /api/review/inferences/:inferenceId/decision (modify); POST /api/review/payments/:paymentId/reclassify.
ui_status: Absent: accept/reject only; rejected inspector has navigation but no correction/retry action.
gaps_limitations: The promised quick correction flow is not available. Reclassification also needs a real AI transport. Rejecting a proposal does not provide a website path to manually repair its classification.

feature: 10. Receipt/image/PDF/screenshot evidence ingestion and retrieval
backend_status: Implemented document validation, content-addressed filesystem storage, metadata and immutable source retrieval.
api_status: Present: POST /api/evidence/files; GET metadata and /content.
ui_status: Partial: existing files can be opened from Evidence Inspector; no upload form.
gaps_limitations: A browser user cannot add a new receipt, statement image or screenshot. There is no evidence library/list endpoint and screen for browsing all stored documents.

feature: 11. Manual explanations, externally-paid evidence and settlement claims
backend_status: Implemented manual notes with distinct note kinds and optional payment/expense links.
api_status: Present: POST /api/evidence/notes.
ui_status: Absent for authoring; existing raw text is readable.
gaps_limitations: Cannot type an explanation or record a non-user settlement claim from the website. A settlement_claim is evidence of belief, not a fabricated bank movement or authoritative settlement.

feature: 12. Bank SMS/UPI push ingestion and structured observation corrections
backend_status: Implemented immutable notifications, deterministic text parsing and explicit observation recording/correction.
api_status: Present: POST /api/evidence/notifications; POST /api/evidence/:evidenceId/observation.
ui_status: Partial: displays existing observations and Find candidates; no ingest or observation-edit form.
gaps_limitations: No phone capture, notification forwarding adapter or user correction screen. Parser support is bounded, not a general understanding of every bank/app notification.

feature: 13. Evidence matching and context reattachment
backend_status: Implemented six-signal candidates, confidence/reasons, deterministic observations, explicit accept/dismiss and write-once linking.
api_status: Present: enrich, matches, match decision, evidence observation and payment context routes.
ui_status: Present: Review → Evidence Inspector → Payment context, with compared values and permanent-link confirmation.
gaps_limitations: Works for evidence already ingested. No direct manual attach-to-expense UI; no UI replacement/superseding-evidence creation when an old write-once link was wrong. The generic /link API exists.

feature: 14. Receipt total/item extraction; image OCR
backend_status: Partial runtime: parseReceipt/extractReceiptItems contracts, validation, derived rows and matching are implemented with injected AI.
api_status: Present: POST /api/evidence/:evidenceId/receipt.
ui_status: Absent: no Extract receipt action.
gaps_limitations: No configured AI provider and no OCR/image-to-text adapter. extractReceipt passes evidence type, media type, rawText and capturedAt; it does not read document bytes from EvidenceStore. Uploading an image alone is not a working receipt-extraction pipeline.

feature: 15. Read, confirm and correct extracted receipt totals/items
backend_status: Implemented getReceipt, confirmReceipt and correctReceipt with inference/audit updates.
api_status: Present: GET /api/receipts/:receiptId; POST /confirm and /correct.
ui_status: Mostly absent: review shows receiptTotal; full ReceiptFacts component and useReceipt hook exist but have no callers.
gaps_limitations: Full extracted receipt item/tax/subtotal/discrepancy review is not mounted on any page. No confirmation or correction controls. File/component existence must not be counted as a shipped website feature.

feature: 16. Expense item creation and receipt-item linkage
backend_status: Implemented complete item-set recording, exact gross-total validation and optional receiptItemId links.
api_status: Present: POST/GET /api/expenses/:expenseId/items.
ui_status: Partial: item gross/refunded/net amounts visible on expense detail; no item-entry or receipt-to-expense item mapping UI.
gaps_limitations: Existing items support refunds, but the website cannot itemize a new expense. Taxes/fees/discount effects must already be represented in the recorded paid-cost basis; there is no dedicated basis editor.

feature: 17. Correct an already-recorded expense item breakdown
backend_status: Not implemented: recordExpenseItems rejects any expense that already has items.
api_status: Absent for correction/versioning.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: Receipt correction is a separate operation and does not repair ExpenseItems. A wrong initial item breakdown has no supported correction workflow, which also blocks reliable item ownership/refund repair.

feature: 18. Create manual expenses, including someone else paying
backend_status: Partial: schema, insert repository function, expense approval/lifecycle and bidirectional calculations support externally-funded expenses. No general manual expense-creation service flow.
api_status: Absent: no POST /api/expenses or evidence-to-expense creation route.
ui_status: Absent for entry; pre-existing externally-paid expenses are readable and affect balances.
gaps_limitations: The flatmate-paid electrician use case is modeled and tested but cannot be entered on the website. Payment classification explicitly rejects a different payer and cannot substitute for an evidence-only creation flow.

feature: 19. One payment → multiple expenses; multiple payments → one expense
backend_status: Partial: PaymentExpenseLink many-to-many persistence, budget validation and calculations exist.
api_status: No public authoring endpoint for splitting/linking funding. Classification decision links its one derived expense.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: The model supports the required shapes, but no website split-order, deposit-plus-balance, or partial-funding editor exists. Do not confuse item allocation within one expense with splitting one payment into multiple conceptual expenses.

feature: 20. Initial beneficiary allocation and reallocation: equal/exact/percentage/item/custom
backend_status: Implemented deterministic allocation, validation, version supersession, group expansion and obligation derivation.
api_status: Present: POST /api/expenses/:expenseId/allocation.
ui_status: Absent for creating/editing allocations. Current lines and refund distribution preview are read-only displays.
gaps_limitations: This is a core website blocker: after accepting a shared expense, the user cannot choose beneficiaries, method or shares. Refund distribution cannot create missing initial item ownership.

feature: 21. Quantity-based allocation
backend_status: Partial semantics: quantity_based is accepted but uses the same item-line amount builder as item_based.
api_status: Present through allocation decision; caller supplies explicit item amounts.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: No quantity-per-beneficiary/unit-price calculator: quantity is not an input to the allocation math. If quantity-based means assign 2 of 3 units and derive the share, that authoring/calculation workflow is not implemented.

feature: 22. Groups and membership snapshots
backend_status: Implemented group schema, as-of-expense membership expansion, per-person amounts and overrides.
api_status: Partial: allocation API accepts groups/overrides; no group/membership management endpoints.
ui_status: Absent for group management, group allocation and expansion inspection.
gaps_limitations: Group beneficiaries are supported by calculations, but users cannot create groups, edit membership dates or inspect the saved expansion from a dedicated web flow.

feature: 23. Whole-expense refunds and third-party reimbursements
backend_status: Implemented immutable gross, adjustment ceiling, net cost, pending distribution and superseding allocations.
api_status: Present: POST adjustments and /adjustments/distribute; GET refund-allocation.
ui_status: Present: expense detail form, kind/amount/date, confirmation, preview and distribution approval.
gaps_limitations: Website flow is real over existing expenses/allocations. It cannot edit/remove a recorded adjustment, choose custom distribution weights, or bind the refund to a credit payment. See rows 27–28.

feature: 24. Item-level partial refund attribution and allocation engine
backend_status: Implemented same-expense checks, complete attribution sum, cumulative ceilings, expense lock, net-item rebuild and prior-settlement preservation.
api_status: Present through adjustments with itemAttributions and refund-allocation read.
ui_status: Present: per-item inputs, paid/refunded/net columns, server-derived projected shares, explicit record/distribute decisions.
gaps_limitations: Not just an ADR or schema: the engine and UI both exist. Requires already-recorded items and item ownership; missing preparation cannot be completed through the website.

feature: 25. Blocked refund ownership and pending distribution
backend_status: Implemented blocked/projected state; refuses ambiguous ownership instead of guessing.
api_status: Present: GET refund-allocation returns reviewRequired/projectedLines/pending reduction.
ui_status: Present warnings and disabled/refused distribution; missing-ownership repair UI is absent.
gaps_limitations: REFUND_ITEM_OWNERSHIP_REQUIRED is an honest stop, but users cannot resolve it without the allocation API. Pending state is shown on expense detail/proof packs, not carried as a pending-refund warning on the Balances page.

feature: 26. Full refunds, zero shares, reverse balances and refund history
backend_status: Implemented zero-valued beneficiary lines, preserved historical allocations, unchanged settlements and signed balances.
api_status: Present through refund state, balances and proof packs; no full allocation/adjustment history endpoint.
ui_status: Partial: zero lines/reverse direction and warnings present; no chronological adjustment log or old allocation viewer.
gaps_limitations: Financial facts survive, but complete purchase→refund-event→allocation-version→settlement history is not inspectable on one website screen.

feature: 27. Link a refund to its actual bank credit
backend_status: Implemented optional adjustmentPaymentId and credit validation, with item-refund credit-budget checks.
api_status: Present: POST adjustments accepts adjustmentPaymentId.
ui_status: Absent: RecordAdjustmentInput and refund form omit this field.
gaps_limitations: Website-created refunds are recorded without bank-credit linkage. The refund can lower an expense while the incoming cash still lacks the evidence/classification needed to be explained in cash reconciliation.

feature: 28. Custom distribution of whole-expense reductions
backend_status: Implemented customWeights for the unattributed whole-expense portion.
api_status: Present: POST adjustments/distribute accepts customWeights.
ui_status: Absent: browser submits reason only; default server projection is shown.
gaps_limitations: Users cannot choose a non-proportional refund/reimbursement distribution through the website. Item-attributed refunds correctly retain item-specific ownership rules.

feature: 29. Manual settlements and peer repayments
backend_status: Implemented settlement events tied to payments, shared explanation budget, debit/credit direction and balance discharge.
api_status: Present: POST /api/payments/:paymentId/settlements.
ui_status: Absent for manual entry. An existing settlement AI proposal can be accepted in Review; recorded settlements appear in proof packs.
gaps_limitations: No payment selector, counterparty/amount form or standalone settlement register. You cannot record a newly received repayment from the website without a pre-existing supported proposal.

feature: 30. Pairwise balances, either payer/direction
backend_status: Implemented current approved allocation obligations minus settlement movements between any two people.
api_status: Present: GET /api/balances/:personAId/:personBId.
ui_status: Present: two-person selectors, owed direction, expense-contribution links and proof-pack navigation.
gaps_limitations: No all-counterparties debt dashboard. Balance response/UI omit settlement line items, so displayed gross contributions do not by themselves explain the net. Pending-refund caveat is not displayed here.

feature: 31. Confirmed versus believed-settled non-user obligations
backend_status: Implemented derived evidence status from settlements, explicit settlement-claim notes and reconciliation data.
api_status: Present in pairwise balance and proof-pack reads.
ui_status: Present through EvidenceStatus labels/tooltips. Claim entry is absent.
gaps_limitations: Third-party-to-third-party discharge remains intentionally unobservable through the user's bank Payments; do not count absence of fabricated third-party settlements as a bug. Users need note-authoring to record a belief.

feature: 32. Expense ledger, filtering and search
backend_status: Implemented gross/net ledger read, state/payer filters and bounded newest-first listing.
api_status: Present: GET /api/expenses and /:expenseId. Default list limit is 200; no cursor/offset.
ui_status: Present description search, state/payer filters and detail links.
gaps_limitations: Search runs only over the returned 200 rows. No Show more/pagination, server-side description search, date/category/beneficiary/unsettled filters, or ledger export. The displayed count is the loaded subset, not a guaranteed full-ledger count.

feature: 33. Immutable evidence, financial audit events and decision history
backend_status: Implemented source protections, audited services, old/new values, actor/reason/time and superseded records.
api_status: Partial: specific finding-review history and contextual reads; no general AuditEvent or allocation-version history API.
ui_status: Partial: proposal provenance and finding-review history; no general financial audit timeline.
gaps_limitations: The backend audit trail is substantially broader than the website. Expense detail lacks direct funding-payment/evidence/history panels; evidence must be reached through other contexts/IDs.

feature: 34. Period reconciliation: legacy outflow identity
backend_status: Implemented outflow minus transfers/investments/debit settlements/net explained self-funded expenses; signed unexplained retained.
api_status: Present: POST/GET /api/reconciliation/runs; GET /:id.
ui_status: Present: period form, history, totals, unexplained amount and discrepancies.
gaps_limitations: Working scope follows ADR-0016. It is independent of cash closing and includes only the defined outflow basis; not a budget/income statement or historical balance replay.

feature: 35. Account cash snapshots and visual waterfall
backend_status: Implemented per-account gross debit/credit identity, evidenced boundaries, signed delta, explained subsets, transfer handling and verification checks.
api_status: Present: account roster, accountBoundaries on run creation, GET run account-snapshots.
ui_status: Present: opening→credits→debits→expected/actual closing, delta, completeness and statement-evidence links.
gaps_limitations: Real implementation and screen, not roadmap-only. Boundary amounts and evidence UUIDs must be entered manually; no statement balance extraction or evidence picker. Cash-category approval and new evidence ingestion remain outside the website.

feature: 36. Drill from cash/unexplained totals to contributing movements
backend_status: Partial: snapshot inputs retain payment facts and cash discrepancies; no general payments listing API.
api_status: Partial: account snapshots expose source inputs, but no per-term movement-list/query route.
ui_status: Partial: boundary evidence links and generic Review/Expenses links. Waterfall terms are not clickable movement lists.
gaps_limitations: The promised drill-through to contributing records is incomplete. The run's Review link is not filtered to that account/period/term and Review omits many unexplained movements.
evidence: src/db/schema.ts#The inputs this run actually read

feature: 37. Live bank/card closing balances
backend_status: Absent external account/balance adapters. Manual boundary support is implemented.
api_status: No live bank balance route.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: The waterfall compares user-supplied evidenced statement boundaries; it does not fetch current bank balances. Live connections remain deferred.

feature: 38. First Splitwise expense/settlement sync and connection setup
backend_status: Implemented first-sync services, resolved person shares, external IDs/responses and ready-to-sync gate. Adapter absent.
api_status: Present: connect, ready-to-sync, expense splitwise-sync, settlement splitwise-sync.
ui_status: Absent: no connect/OAuth, person-ID mapping, preview/confirm sync or first-sync buttons.
gaps_limitations: The Splitwise tab is an audit screen. connect only writes integration metadata; it does not authenticate to Splitwise. The running port rejects every remote operation.

feature: 39. Splitwise drift, ghost debt and findings review
backend_status: Implemented aggregate/per-record comparisons: missing/duplicate expenses and settlements, stale/full/item refunds, amount differences, unsupported debt and unattributed residuals.
api_status: Present: run/read audits, list/detail findings and review decisions.
ui_status: Present: external-read status, findings, compared snapshots, explanations and review history/actions.
gaps_limitations: Real audit engine and UI, but live comparisons are blocked by the missing adapter. Current local screen explicitly reports read failure; seeded historical findings are not evidence of a working live connection. Reviews never repair Splitwise.

feature: 40. Stale re-sync, update/delete repair and bidirectional sync
backend_status: Absent lifecycle beyond first sync and auditing. Existing sync rejects any already-created SplitwiseExpense.
api_status: Absent for re-sync/update/delete/pull-and-apply.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: stale and drifted are meaningful states/findings, not implemented repair actions. Resolving a finding records a conclusion; it neither changes remote data nor applies remote edits locally.

feature: 41. Proof-pack preview, redaction and copy/export
backend_status: Implemented recipient-isolated derived pack: spend/items/refunds/net shares, settlements, balance, evidence refs and uncertainty warnings.
api_status: Present: GET /api/proof-packs/:recipientPersonId, optional asOf label.
ui_status: Present: recipient selection, warning-first exact text preview, three review checks and clipboard copy.
gaps_limitations: Text export is implemented. asOf labels the current read; it does not reconstruct the ledger at a historical date. No saved-pack record, PDF/ZIP attachment bundle or evidence-selection editor. Those are not required by the accepted derived-read design.

feature: 42. One-click WhatsApp/recipient-facing sending
backend_status: Absent message transport.
api_status: Absent send endpoint.
ui_status: Absent sending/share-to-WhatsApp action; copy only.
gaps_limitations: The pillar name overstates present delivery capability. Copying prepares text for manual use elsewhere; it does not send a message, package recipient-accessible attachments or record a settlement.

feature: 43. Rules, learning and high-confidence automatic approval
backend_status: Schema only for Rules and permitted rule actor labels; no rule CRUD/evaluator/learner or application engine.
api_status: Absent.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: Every pending AI proposal still needs a decision. High confidence affects review routing, not authority. No standing-rule workflow, learning from corrections, automatic shared-expense reminders or recurring rule execution.

feature: 44. Analytics: own spending by category/person/time, trends and outstanding lists
backend_status: No analytics service beyond existing reconciliation, balances and expense listing.
api_status: Absent analytics queries.
ui_status: Absent analytics dashboard/charts/reports.
gaps_limitations: Questions such as own spend last month or every unreimbursed paid-on-behalf expense are not directly answered by the existing payer/state filters. No period/category/beneficiary aggregation or unsettled-expense view.

feature: 45. Natural-language interface
backend_status: Absent conversational ledger/query/command engine.
api_status: Absent.
ui_status: Absent chat or ask-your-ledger screen.
gaps_limitations: Cmd+K is navigation search. It is not natural-language expense entry, question answering or anomaly explanation.

feature: 46. Other promised AI helpers
backend_status: Absent: normalizeMerchant, suggestBeneficiaries, suggestAllocation, groupIntoOccasion, explainAnomaly, proposeRule.
api_status: Absent for these six operations.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: Only classifyTransaction, parseReceipt and extractReceiptItems are implemented contracts. Deterministic matching/findings and refund projections do not implement the six missing AI operations.

feature: 47. Expense occasions: dinner/dessert/cab grouped together
backend_status: Schema/domain representation only: expense_occasions and expense occasionId.
api_status: Absent occasion CRUD/grouping/query endpoints.
ui_status: Absent.
gaps_limitations: No manual occasion flow or AI occasion-grouping implementation. Explicitly deferred domain-level requirement.

feature: 48. People/accounts/merchants/groups onboarding and management
backend_status: Partial: persistent models, read helpers and seed/low-level writes; no end-user onboarding service workflow.
api_status: Read-only GET /api/people and /api/accounts; no roster/account/merchant/group CRUD surface.
ui_status: Selectors exist; setup/edit/archive/import mappings are absent.
gaps_limitations: A new empty installation cannot be populated entirely through the website. This also blocks real allocation participants, owned-account reconciliation, aliases and Splitwise person mapping.

feature: 49. Local PII sanitization boundary
backend_status: Implemented redaction builders, residual-identifier assertions, local reversible map and sanitized proof-pack checks.
api_status: Applied internally to supported AI operations and proof-pack read.
ui_status: Local source inspection and separate recipient redaction/copy review are present.
gaps_limitations: This is implemented for the defined text/payload paths. It is not an operational privacy validation of unbuilt OCR, new provider adapters or deployment infrastructure. No redaction-settings editor.

feature: 50. Authentication and deployable personal-data boundary
backend_status: Not implemented: one primary user is loaded from DB; actor strings identify decisions, not authenticated sessions.
api_status: No session/login/auth middleware. Server exposes its route dispatcher and CORS configuration.
ui_status: Absent login/logout/settings.
gaps_limitations: Documented single-user session auth remains deferred. Treat this as a real prerequisite before making personal financial data available over a network; CORS and actor: user do not authenticate callers.

feature: 51. Background imports/extraction jobs, retry and scheduling
backend_status: Absent planned jobs table/worker. Existing work is synchronous service/request execution.
api_status: No job status/retry/scheduler routes.
ui_status: Absent progress/retry queue for imports or extraction.
gaps_limitations: Architecture promises a lightweight Postgres-backed job queue, but there is no implementation. Not a blocker for small synchronous core calculations; relevant when ingestion/provider integrations are added.

feature: 52. Exact money and currency scope
backend_status: Implemented BigInt paise, deterministic rounding, signed balances and refusal of unsupported/mixed currencies.
api_status: Exact minor-unit strings cross HTTP.
ui_status: INR formatting and exact rupee input are implemented.
gaps_limitations: INR-only is intentional. Multi-currency/FX, investment returns, general budgets and tax calculations are not implemented and are not missing core features under the accepted current scope.

feature: 53. Keyboard navigation, review workspace and explicit decisions
backend_status: UI concern; backend decisions remain explicit audited writes.
api_status: Uses existing read/decision routes.
ui_status: Implemented six sections, eleven screens, Cmd/Ctrl+K, help, g navigation, j/k/Enter triage, modal isolation and responsive views.
gaps_limitations: Fresh browser smoke passed for all eleven screens; expense search, palette, review/refund dialogs and proof-copy gating were exercised. This is interface coverage, not evidence that missing authoring flows or real adapters exist.

feature: 54. Complete reconciliation and audit history browsing
backend_status: Implemented stored runs and finding records, plus limited history reads.
api_status: Present history/read routes and configurable limits, but no offset/cursor pagination.
ui_status: Partial: latest 20 reconciliation runs, 10 Splitwise audits and 50 findings; no Show more for these lists.
gaps_limitations: Older history is not reachable through these list screens. Splitwise GET audit/:id has a wrapper/hook but no mounted run-detail consumer. Specific finding details are reachable; Review Show more does not extend these separate lists.
